grh_9c15518dcbd36a2c9be2.title: On To Glory
paragraphs: Aunt Tanny has no serious physical disease, but she has convinced herself that her time has come and has arranged her final days as carefully as a performance, calling in relatives, revising her will and taking comfort in a fully paid burial policy that promises a proper funeral. Dr. Christian realizes that the attention and drama surrounding death have become more appealing to her than recovery. He secretly has the burial policy removed just as Tanny appears ready to make her grand exit. The shock of discovering that her carefully planned funeral is no longer assured immediately rouses her anger, energy and will to live. Dr. Christian tells her she has suffered a rare malady requiring exactly such a shock and reminds her of the husband, blind brother, nieces and friends who still depend on her. Tanny abandons her trip to glory and begins recovering.

grh_9c7e3bc82d75001fd278.title: Greek Meets Greek
paragraphs: In Greece, Harry becomes involved with a woman whose shifting stories conceal a scheme to deliver crates of weapons to killers. After gunfire, false identities and an escape through back streets to a waiting ship, Harry and his companion complete the delivery and collect the final payment. She then reveals the real double cross: the machine guns may be genuine, but the ammunition she supplied does not fit them because she refuses to help the buyers kill anyone. Their accomplice Gregor does not survive the surrounding treachery, while Harry and the woman divide the blood money and briefly consider a partnership before discovering they are too much alike to trust each other.

grh_9cf1e916c10d2eaa4b2e.title: Call Northside 777
paragraphs: Chicago reporter McNeil reopens the case of Frank Wiecek, imprisoned for the murder of a policeman after an identification by speakeasy owner Wanda Skutnik. What begins as a human-interest story driven by Frank's mother's long campaign becomes a search for evidence that the conviction was wrong. McNeil finally finds a newspaper photograph showing Skutnik with Frank before the date she swore she first saw him; an enlargement reveals the date on a newsboy's paper as December 22. The proof establishes perjured identification testimony and wins Frank his freedom after years in prison.

grh_9c1b28121d8666e47dff.title: The Wrong Arm of Justice
paragraphs: District Attorney Jay is drawn into a secret vigilante court formed to retry gangster William Reed after a legal acquittal. The group insists it is acting for justice, but Jay demonstrates the danger by presenting an entirely fabricated case and watching the men accept it as readily as real evidence. He then reveals the deception, leaves Reed a way to escape and tells the group that law and order cannot be preserved by violating the law. Jay returns to the legitimate task of building another lawful case against Reed instead of joining the mob's private execution.

grh_9ce9e914894250a295ba.title: Two Loves Had Marian
paragraphs: Marian Douglas comes to Rivers End trying to find the soldier she remembers as David Rodell, a tall dark man she met at a New York servicemen's canteen and quickly fell in love with. Throughout the war she wrote to David Rodell overseas and fell even more deeply in love through his letters. When the real Rivers End David returned, however, he was shorter and blond, and Marian was so certain he was an impostor that she had him arrested for bothering her. Military records prove that the returning man is the genuine David and the man who actually received and answered Marian's wartime letters. Dr. Christian concludes that Marian has fused the real David's written personality with an idealized physical image formed around the stranger she first met. He recreates the emotional setting in which Marian originally fell in love, arranging a park encounter surrounded by butterflies. The memories finally join the real man to the feelings she already had for him. Marian recognizes David, the two marry the next morning, and Christian admits he helped the butterflies along with a little sugar water.
GRH catalogs [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]]'s "Two Loves Had Marian" for July 3, 1946, as episode 397.
